parsed.explanation: The parent regime creates active traveler-facing exposure: sex-marker passport/visa policy, document-mismatch refusals and possible lifetime fraud findings, allied advisories, and documented stranding. State/province facilities rules are uneven, but some jurisdictions criminalize congruent facility use; a first capitol arrest shows enforcement risk. Immigration/corrections reports describe conversion therapy, beatings, solitary and sexual abuse, a severe consequence if detained. Local minor-care and surgery restrictions are mostly resident-facing; raw violence counts without denominators/baseline are not weighted as a campaign. Litigation and protective state/provinces reduce severity but do not erase border, document and facility/custody exposures. High risk, severe if outed, below organized raids/extortion.
